items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: years later after I had been singing with the Kirby Band for a while

ctx.x: And I auditioned and every gin mill from 155th Street down to 52nd Street that day -- we went into clubs --

In fact, years later after I had been singing with the Kirby Band for a while and Billy Kyle -- you got Billy Kyle there -- Billy reminded me that he was one of the piano players that happened to be in one of the clubs that I auditioned and he played for me.
Claude didn't play -- everyone was there, and that got to be quite a thing.
